name: Speech-To-Text
descr: Whisper Speech-To-Text aims to transcribe speech. Its result HAS TO BE manually VERIFIED. Requires IPUs. Produces an approx. standard ortho. transcription into IPUs.

options.text: Input pattern of the file with the IPUs.
Output pattern of the file with the approx. transcription of Whisper.
The Whisper model name (e.g., tiny, base, small, medium, large).
Initial prompt: prefix text to bias transcription. Not guaranteed.
